summary: legal checked in 7 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: BLOCKED for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, and advertising. Woot documentation establishes API access mechanics only; current public terms do not evidence rights to store, derive, cache, display, alert on, or monetize deal and price-history data. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only; keep outreach unsent pending counsel review and owner authorization. Ordinary reversible growth elsewhere remains conditional when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior.

Launch-readiness tracking is active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 remain open. No task is closed because direct evidence remains missing. Existing progress is limited to official Woot API, terms, and support review; partial repository/configuration evidence; privacy and cookie-policy artifacts; and draft site terms. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering rights, data flow, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 configuration and retention, log fields, vendors, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Fleet compliance evidence is incomplete: 37 sites pass, 16 fail, and 6 are unknown, with open banner, accept, reject, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Treat this as a technical baseline, not certification. Next evidence action: enumerate authoritative failing and unknown checks and attach dated remediation evidence or an explicit blocker for each. Do not block ordinary reversible growth solely because telemetry is incomplete.

Revenue and data-quality disposition: preserve the 2026-09-21 Amazon result as aggregate and unattributed—6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission under tracking ID other. Data quality is yellow for revenue attribution because the provider aggregate cannot be assigned to a site without inventing attribution. Keep margin, ROI, forecasts, payback, and causal lift unknown; authorize no spend or monetization expansion. Analytics health is available for configured sites and does not require duplicate telemetry.

Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics or affiliate configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue admission is cleared. Continue only the existing readiness packets. Next evidence action: attach dated ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement-boundary, rollback, and explicit-blocker evidence for each property by 2026-09-30T17:00Z; escalate incomplete packets to CTO.

The proposed SEO, CTA, affiliate, CRO, and site-factory work is not legally cleared for new production admission this cycle. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 and existing measurement, repair, security, and readiness gates remain open. Preserve candidates as slot-gated specifications only; do not requeue unchanged work or add telemetry. Ordinary reversible work may proceed only after capacity release and confirmation that consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries remain unchanged.

items.title: Maintain private launch gate and complete evidence work
items.summary: Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only while upstream rights, privacy, consent, data-flow, security, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Maintain containment-only execution and allow only bounded read-only evidence work or reversible growth that preserves existing legal and compliance boundaries.
items.requested_action: Continue the four existing launch-readiness tasks without closing any task absent direct evidence. Keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization. Produce the consolidated read-only evidence bundle, route upstream-rights and jurisdictional gaps to human counsel, and retain the private launch gate.
